posts.cooked:
[Edit]: Totally was a thread for this already, it just hasn't had a new post for awhile. Still, going to leave this thread up, since it at the very least is a nice compilled list of them all, something the other thread doesn't seem to have. The other thread has better overall speculation and you can find the link for it here: https://greaterthangames.com/forum/topic/the-potential-scions-of-oblivaeon-8608

As a preface, I first want to say that if this is a repeat of another topic, or if this question has been answered before, I apologize and will move my conversation or delete it if it's redundant. But if not, I feel this topic must be discussed!

So with the most recent kickstarter update, I believe we now know all but ONE of the scions from Oblivaeon. While we have not seen all their cards yet, nor gotten complete oficial confirmations on all of these (I think), I believe this is the comprehensive list we have thus far. If you know the official confirmation for any of these, please post it, and I will try to update this list accordingly.

1. Progeny (Kickstarter Update 6)

2. Aeon Master (Kickstarter Update 37)

3. Dark Mind (Kickstarter Update 37)

4. Sanction (Kickstarter Update 37)

5. Borr (Kickstarter Update 39)

6. Empyreon (Kickstarter Update 39)

7. Nixious (Kickstarter Update 39)

8. Faultless (Mentioned in several episodes of the letters page podcast, including Expatriette, Setback, and Mr. Fixer)

9. Voidsoul (Art done on Twitch Stream, also mentioned in the F.I.L.T.E.R. episode of the letters page podcast)

10. ???

 

So by my count, if we consider Voidspawn a confirmed Scion (please correct me if I'm wrong on that one), we only have 1 scion still unaccounted for. So my question is, who is this mystery Scion? Christopher has said the scions will be about half old characters and half new ones, so he/she could by either one (depending on how you count Voidspawn, since as far as I know he's never been named in the card game).

So who do we think this last Scion is? Let's try to figure this out!

posts.cooked:
It's a good thing KNYFE didn't run into an army of Unitys on Mars.  She'd be toast in a second.

Anyway, we've also seen a trend of Scions being characters we've seen on previous cards but never named.  It's probably not the dorky spaceman on Blackout, though I'd like it to be.  I thought it could be the green guy on Lightspeed Barrage and Demoralizing Presence, but then I realized that there probably aren't any Scions represented on Tactics cards (there haven't been so far).  That would leave out Voss as well.
